description: Compares two Claude Code sessions -- files, tools, branches, topics.

evals.name: Compare yesterday vs today sessions
evals.prompt: What changed between yesterday's session and today's session in this project?
evals.expected_output: Resolves two sessions by date/recency, runs the diff script, reports file/tool/topic differences as a side-by-side narrative.

evals.name: Compare two explicitly-given session IDs
evals.prompt: Compare sessions 7b92a813-0321-4dbb-b37a-c62dfc1207e7 and ab822c24-09b8-4673-a4bf-beb585238b75 -- what files changed between them?
evals.expected_output: Resolves and diffs exactly the two GIVEN session IDs directly (regression test for a fixed ID-resolution bug), not two different/most-recent sessions.
